replies.hub.title: 💬 Auto replies
replies.hub.sub: When someone comments a keyword on your Instagram post, we reply and DM them the link by ourselves.
replies.needWorker: Auto replies need the Scout Worker and your Instagram account connected in Settings.
replies.needPermission: We need Instagram's permission to reply to comments and send messages.
replies.autoNote: We check the comments every 5 minutes by ourselves and only answer new ones.
replies.deleteBody: We will stop answering these keywords.
replies.form.title: Auto reply
replies.form.keywordsHint: Separate them with commas. Diacritics, capitals and emoji don't matter.
replies.form.match.exact: The comment is exactly the word
replies.form.dmHint: Links go out as lines under the message; Instagram allows no buttons in the first message.
replies.empty: No auto replies yet. Add the first one: the word “لت” on the LUT post, for example.
replies.tester.title: Try a comment
replies.log.title: Recent replies
replies.problem.keywordTooLong: That keyword is too long ({max} characters at most).
replies.problem.dmTooLong: The message is too long ({max} characters at most).
replies.problem.publicTooLong: The public reply is too long ({max} characters at most).
replies.err.notConnected: Instagram is not connected; connect it in Settings.
replies.err.noPermission: No permission to reply; press “Allow auto-replies”.
replies.err.rateLimited: Instagram asked us to slow down; we continue on the next check.
replies.err.notEligible: Instagram takes no private reply to this comment (older than 7 days, already answered privately, deleted, or the account blocks message requests).
replies.notice.busy: A check is already running; try again in a minute.
